r6-001.gate_key: rep_questions | B1.2 | order | Put the words in order. | she asked me what time the bus arrived

key.sentence: she asked me what time the bus arrived

item.why: In a reported question the word order is like a statement: subject + verb (*where I lived*), with no *do / does / did*, and the verb goes one step back.
item.why_lv: Atstāstītā jautājumā vārdu secība ir kā apgalvojumā: teikuma priekšmets + darbības vārds (*where I lived*), bez *do / does / did*, un laiks pāriet vienu soli atpakaļ.
